selection.selectionMetric: Mode-balanced mean weighted absolute rank-rate error, rank weights 1/1/1/2/3

development.selectionMetric: Mean across modes of weighted absolute rank-rate error; rank weights 1/1/1/2/3

limitations: The October 3–November 15 period was previously reviewed and is not a blind test.
The genuinely fresh check covers one day and five boards, with no fresh free-play games.
Bootstrap intervals are conditional on fitted models and resample seven-day blocks, not individual players.
No player identifiers were exported, so population changes cannot be separated from board effects.
